supersedes_claim: I12R1 claims superseded by operator review: (1) the default ERROR_ON_AMBIGUITY policy executed without the I06 revision authority; (2) a query requesting T0B could silently return only T0A when no requested T0B schema matched (option-A fallback).  I12R2 measures the fail-safe repairs END-TO-END through RawEvidenceQueryService.execute().

rows.detail: BLOCKER A repaired: the DEFAULT ERROR_ON_AMBIGUITY policy is a revision-resolution policy; an unwired service executes NO raw evidence query (previously returned both revisions with no authority consulted)
FIRST_SEEN: the unwired refusal is the SAME typed class as the default policy — no policy bypasses the authority requirement
EXACT_REVISION: the unwired refusal is the SAME typed class as the default policy — no policy bypasses the authority requirement
ALL: the unwired refusal is the SAME typed class as the default policy — no policy bypasses the authority requirement
with the accepted I06 authority wired, the default policy executes the reduction through registry resolution
two revisions under one source key + wired authority + default policy: typed epistemic ambiguity — the authority is actually CONSULTED, not merely accepted at construction
limit=1 cannot suppress the ambiguity: the authority is consulted during reduction, before ordering and truncation
the unwired refusal is a configuration/authority failure — never StorageBackendUnavailable, NoMatchingEvidence or RevisionAmbiguity
the public constructor exposes NO allow_unresolved_revisions / unsafe_revision_passthrough / legacy_mode escape hatch (§5)
Synthetic counterfactual for AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: deliberately invalid execution path that must evaluate FAIL; not a measured row.
